title: Teddy's V0.1 | Open-source
features:
Basic shit-code trait spoofer for Decaying Winter.
Works on low-level executors.
Includes Workbench ESP.
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local CONFIG_FILE_NAME = "TraitDebuggerConfig.json"

local function saveSettings(data)
	local jsonString = HttpService:JSONEncode(data)
	
	if writefile then
		pcall(function() writefile(CONFIG_FILE_NAME, jsonString) end)
	end
	
	pcall(function()
		TeleportService:SetTeleportSetting("TraitDebuggerConfig", jsonString)
	end)
end

local function loadSettings()
	local rawData = nil
	
	if readfile and isfile and isfile(CONFIG_FILE_NAME) then
		pcall(function() rawData = readfile(CONFIG_FILE_NAME) end)
	end
	
	if not rawData then
		pcall(function() rawData = TeleportService:GetTeleportSetting("TraitDebuggerConfig") end)
	end
	
	if rawData then
		local success, decoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(rawData) end)
		if success and type(decoded) == "table" then
			return decoded
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local workbenchEspEnabled = true
local WORKBENCH_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 150)
local WORKBENCH_HL_NAME = "WorkbenchESP"
local leaderboardVisible = true

local function setLeaderboardState(state)
	leaderboardVisible = state
	pcall(function()
		StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, leaderboardVisible)
	end)
end

local function purgeCustomLeaderboards()
	local playerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	if not playerGui then return end
	local commonLeaderboardNames = {"leaderboard", "playerlist", "tabmenu", "scoreboard"}
	for _, ui in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
		local lowerName = string.lower(ui.Name)
		for _, targetName in ipairs(commonLeaderboardNames) do
			if string.find(lowerName, targetName) then
				ui:Destroy()
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

local playerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
playerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
	if not leaderboardVisible then purgeCustomLeaderboards() end
end)

local function clearWorkbenchHighlights()
	for _, desc in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("Highlight") and desc.Name == WORKBENCH_HL_NAME then
			desc:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local function applyWorkbenchHighlight(obj)
	if not workbenchEspEnabled then return end
	if obj.Name == "Workbench" and not obj:FindFirstChild(WORKBENCH_HL_NAME) then
		local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
		hl.Name = WORKBENCH_HL_NAME
		hl.Adornee = obj
		hl.FillColor = WORKBENCH_COLOR
		hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		hl.FillTransparency = 0.4
		hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
		hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		hl.Parent = obj
	end
end

local function refreshWorkbenchESP()
	clearWorkbenchHighlights()
	if not workbenchEspEnabled then return end
	for _, desc in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		applyWorkbenchHighlight(desc)
	end
end

Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
	if desc.Name == "Workbench" then
		task.wait(0.1)
		applyWorkbenchHighlight(desc)
	end
end)

local traitCategories = {
	{
		title = "MELEE TRAITS",
		traits = {
			{id = "rustic",   name = "Methodical",          desc = "+15% melee damage"},
			{id = "manic",    name = "Manic",               desc = "+45% heavy swing speed"},
			{id = "boxer",    name = "Aggressive Behavior", desc = "+25% fist damage & faster shove"},
			{id = "violence", name = "Violent Tendencies",  desc = "+45% light swing speed"},
			{id = "honor",    name = "Honourable",          desc = "2x fist damage"}
		}
	},
	{
		title = "GUN TRAITS",
		traits = {
			{id = "recoil",   name = "Professional",        desc = "Reduced sway & -65% recoil"},
			{id = "hip",      name = "Lone Wolf",           desc = "+65% hipfire speed, +50% lever/revolver ROF"},
			{id = "reliab",   name = "Reliable",            desc = "+65% reload speed"},
			{id = "paranoia", name = "Paranoid",            desc = "+50% semi-auto ROF"}
		}
	},
	{
		title = "DEFENSIVE TRAITS",
		traits = {
			{id = "regen",    name = "Survivor",            desc = "+6 HP/min passive regen"}
		}
	},
	{
		title = "UTILITY & MOBILITY",
		traits = {
			{id = "second",   name = "Relentless",          desc = "Increased stamina regen"},
			{id = "leg",      name = "Impatient",           desc = "+15% movement speed"},
			{id = "lungs",    name = "Calm",                desc = "+75 stamina"}
		}
	}
}

local savedTraits = {}
for _, cat in ipairs(traitCategories) do
	for _, traitData in ipairs(cat.traits) do
		savedTraits[traitData.id] = false
	end
end

local savedUiPosition = {XScale = 0, XOffset = 30, YScale = 0.5, YOffset = -255}
local savedUiVisible = true

local loadedConfig = loadSettings()
if loadedConfig then
	if loadedConfig.traits then
		for traitId, state in pairs(loadedConfig.traits) do
			if savedTraits[traitId] ~= nil then
				savedTraits[traitId] = state
			end
		end
	end
	if loadedConfig.workbenchEsp ~= nil then workbenchEspEnabled = loadedConfig.workbenchEsp end
	if loadedConfig.leaderboard ~= nil then leaderboardVisible = loadedConfig.leaderboard end
	if loadedConfig.uiPosition then savedUiPosition = loadedConfig.uiPosition end
	if loadedConfig.uiVisible ~= nil then savedUiVisible = loadedConfig.uiVisible end
end

local function persistCurrentState(mainFrame)
	local pos = mainFrame and mainFrame.Position or UDim2.new(savedUiPosition.XScale, savedUiPosition.XOffset, savedUiPosition.YScale, savedUiPosition.YOffset)
	local isVis = mainFrame and mainFrame.Visible or savedUiVisible

	saveSettings({
		traits = savedTraits,
		workbenchEsp = workbenchEspEnabled,
		leaderboard = leaderboardVisible,
		uiPosition = {
			XScale = pos.X.Scale,
			XOffset = pos.X.Offset,
			YScale = pos.Y.Scale,
			YOffset = pos.Y.Offset
		},
		uiVisible = isVis
	})
end

local function getPlayerCharacterModel()
	local activePlayers = Workspace:FindFirstChild("activePlayers")
	if not activePlayers then return nil end
	return activePlayers:FindFirstChild(LocalPlayer.Name)
end

local function getPerksFolder()
	local char = getPlayerCharacterModel()
	if not char then return nil end
	local perksFolder = char:FindFirstChild("perks")
	if not perksFolder then
		perksFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		perksFolder.Name = "perks"
		perksFolder.Parent = char
	end
	return perksFolder
end

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "TraitDebuggerPanel"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 510)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(savedUiPosition.XScale, savedUiPosition.XOffset, savedUiPosition.YScale, savedUiPosition.YOffset)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Visible = savedUiVisible
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local mainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
mainCorner.Parent = mainFrame

local mainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
mainStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
mainStroke.Thickness = 1
mainStroke.Parent = mainFrame

local titleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
titleBar.Name = "TitleBar"
titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 32)
titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
titleBar.Parent = mainFrame

local titleText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, 0)
titleText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
titleText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
titleText.Text = "TRAIT DEBUGGER"
titleText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 230)
titleText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
titleText.TextSize = 12
titleText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
titleText.Parent = titleBar

local toggleAllBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleAllBtn.Name = "ToggleAllButton"
toggleAllBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 85, 0, 24)
toggleAllBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -93, 0.5, -12)
toggleAllBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 48)
toggleAllBtn.Text = "ENABLE ALL"
toggleAllBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 215)
toggleAllBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
toggleAllBtn.TextSize = 10
toggleAllBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
toggleAllBtn.Parent = titleBar

local controlBar = Instance.new("Frame")
controlBar.Name = "ControlBar"
controlBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 28)
controlBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 44)
controlBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 30)
controlBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
controlBar.Parent = mainFrame

local controlCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
controlCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
controlCorner.Parent = controlBar

local wbToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
wbToggleBtn.Name = "WBToggleButton"
wbToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.48, 0, 1, -4)
wbToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 2)
wbToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = workbenchEspEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(38, 120, 65) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 40, 45)
wbToggleBtn.Text = workbenchEspEnabled and "WORKBENCH ESP: ON" or "WORKBENCH ESP: OFF"
wbToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 250, 230)
wbToggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
wbToggleBtn.TextSize = 9
wbToggleBtn.Parent = controlBar

local lbToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
lbToggleBtn.Name = "LBToggleButton"
lbToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.48, 0, 1, -4)
lbToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.52, 0, 0, 2)
lbToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = leaderboardVisible and Color3.fromRGB(38, 120, 65) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 40, 45)
lbToggleBtn.Text = leaderboardVisible and "LEADERBOARD: ON" or "LEADERBOARD: OFF"
lbToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 250, 230)
lbToggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
lbToggleBtn.TextSize = 9
lbToggleBtn.Parent = controlBar

local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
scroll.Name = "MainList"
scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -82)
scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 76)
scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4
scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 75)
scroll.Parent = mainFrame

local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
listLayout.Parent = scroll
listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)

listLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
	scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, listLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 16)
end)

local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = mainFrame.Position
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
				persistCurrentState(mainFrame)
			end
		end)
	end
end)

titleBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragInput = input
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input == dragInput and dragging then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightBracket then
		mainFrame.Visible = not mainFrame.Visible
		persistCurrentState(mainFrame)
	end
end)

local traitUI = {}
local layoutCounter = 0

local function updateUI()
	local perksFolder = getPerksFolder()
	local allTraitsActive = true

	for traitId, uiGroup in pairs(traitUI) do
		local valueName = "trait:" .. traitId
		local existsInGame = perksFolder and perksFolder:FindFirstChild(valueName)
		local isActive = savedTraits[traitId] or (existsInGame ~= nil)

		if isActive then
			uiGroup.Card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 50, 38)
			uiGroup.Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 120, 75)
			uiGroup.Badge.Text = "ACTIVE"
			uiGroup.Badge.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 120)
		else
			uiGroup.Card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 30)
			uiGroup.Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 48)
			uiGroup.Badge.Text = "INACTIVE"
			uiGroup.Badge.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 135)
			allTraitsActive = false
		end
	end

	if allTraitsActive then
		toggleAllBtn.Text = "DISABLE ALL"
		toggleAllBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 32, 32)
		toggleAllBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 120, 120)
	else
		toggleAllBtn.Text = "ENABLE ALL"
		toggleAllBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 48)
		toggleAllBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 215)
	end
end

local function applyStateToFolder()
	local perksFolder = getPerksFolder()
	if not perksFolder then return false end

	local noneVal = perksFolder:FindFirstChild("trait:none")
	if noneVal then noneVal:Destroy() end

	for traitId, isEnabled in pairs(savedTraits) do
		local valueName = "trait:" .. traitId
		local existingVal = perksFolder:FindFirstChild(valueName)

		if isEnabled and not existingVal then
			local boolVal = Instance.new("BoolValue")
			boolVal.Name = valueName
			boolVal.Value = false
			boolVal.Parent = perksFolder
		elseif not isEnabled and existingVal then
			existingVal:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return true
end

for _, categoryData in ipairs(traitCategories) do
	layoutCounter = layoutCounter + 1

	local headerLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	headerLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
	headerLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	headerLabel.Text = categoryData.title
	headerLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 180)
	headerLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	headerLabel.TextSize = 10
	headerLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	headerLabel.LayoutOrder = layoutCounter
	headerLabel.Parent = scroll

	for _, traitData in ipairs(categoryData.traits) do
		layoutCounter = layoutCounter + 1
		local traitId = traitData.id

		local card = Instance.new("TextButton")
		card.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 48)
		card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 30)
		card.AutoButtonColor = false
		card.Text = ""
		card.LayoutOrder = layoutCounter
		card.Parent = scroll

		local cardCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		cardCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
		cardCorner.Parent = card

		local cardStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		cardStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 48)
		cardStroke.Thickness = 1
		cardStroke.Parent = card

		local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 20)
		nameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6)
		nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		nameLabel.Text = traitData.name
		nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245)
		nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
		nameLabel.TextSize = 13
		nameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		nameLabel.Parent = card

		local descLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		descLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 16)
		descLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 26)
		descLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		descLabel.Text = traitData.desc
		descLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 155)
		descLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		descLabel.TextSize = 11
		descLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		descLabel.Parent = card

		local badge = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		badge.Size = UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 20)
		badge.Position = UDim2.new(1, -73, 0.5, -10)
		badge.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		badge.Text = "INACTIVE"
		badge.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 135)
		badge.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		badge.TextSize = 10
		badge.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		badge.Parent = card

		traitUI[traitId] = {Card = card, Stroke = cardStroke, Badge = badge}

		card.Activated:Connect(function()
			savedTraits[traitId] = not savedTraits[traitId]
			applyStateToFolder()
			updateUI()
			persistCurrentState(mainFrame)
		end)
	end
end

toggleAllBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	local targetState = false
	for traitId, state in pairs(savedTraits) do
		if not state then
			targetState = true
			break
		end
	end

	for traitId in pairs(savedTraits) do
		savedTraits[traitId] = targetState
	end

	applyStateToFolder()
	updateUI()
	persistCurrentState(mainFrame)
end)

wbToggleBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	workbenchEspEnabled = not workbenchEspEnabled
	wbToggleBtn.Text = workbenchEspEnabled and "WORKBENCH ESP: ON" or "WORKBENCH ESP: OFF"
	wbToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = workbenchEspEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(38, 120, 65) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 40, 45)
	refreshWorkbenchESP()
	persistCurrentState(mainFrame)
end)

lbToggleBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	setLeaderboardState(not leaderboardVisible)
	lbToggleBtn.Text = leaderboardVisible and "LEADERBOARD: ON" or "LEADERBOARD: OFF"
	lbToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = leaderboardVisible and Color3.fromRGB(38, 120, 65) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 40, 45)
	persistCurrentState(mainFrame)
end)

local function hookPerks(perks)
	perks.ChildAdded:Connect(updateUI)
	perks.ChildRemoved:Connect(updateUI)
	applyStateToFolder()
	updateUI()
end

local function watchCharacter(char)
	if not char then return end
	local existingPerks = char:FindFirstChild("perks")
	if existingPerks then
		hookPerks(existingPerks)
	end
	char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child.Name == "perks" then
			hookPerks(child)
		end
	end)
	applyStateToFolder()
end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		local applied = applyStateToFolder()
		updateUI()
		if applied then break end
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
end)

local function setupWatcher()
	local activePlayers = Workspace:WaitForChild("activePlayers", 15)
	if not activePlayers then return end

	activePlayers.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child.Name == LocalPlayer.Name then
			watchCharacter(child)
		end
	end)

	local existingChar = activePlayers:FindFirstChild(LocalPlayer.Name)
	if existingChar then
		watchCharacter(existingChar)
	end
end

setupWatcher()
refreshWorkbenchESP()
setLeaderboardState(leaderboardVisible)
updateUI()
